shortDescription: Manage OIDC database users in Atlas

options.name: api_password
options.description: Atlas API private key. Alternative to C(service_account_secret).

options.name: api_username
options.description: Atlas API public key. Alternative to C(service_account_id).

options.name: database_name
options.description: Database against which Atlas authenticates the user. Must be C($external) for C(USER) and C(admin) for C(IDP_GROUP).

options.name: group_id
options.description: Unique identifier of the Atlas project (group).

options.name: oidc_auth_type
options.description: OIDC authentication type. C(USER) for individual human users authenticated via OIDC. C(IDP_GROUP) for IdP groups mapped to MongoDB roles.

options.name: roles
options.description: Array of roles and the databases on which the roles apply.

options.name: service_account_id
options.description: MongoDB Atlas Service Account client ID (OAuth2). Mutually exclusive with C(api_username).

options.name: service_account_secret
options.description: MongoDB Atlas Service Account client secret (OAuth2). Mutually exclusive with C(api_password).

options.name: username
options.description: Username for OIDC USER or IdP group identifier for IDP_GROUP. For IDP_GROUP format is C(<idp_id>/<group_name>).
